PostgreSQL / Prisma Multi-Vendor Schema

Ready-to-use relational schema covering RBAC, Seller KYC, Escrow Orders, and Disputes

schema.prisma 
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role { SUPER_ADMIN SELLER BUYER }
enum KycStatus { PENDING VERIFIED SUSPENDED }
enum OrderStatus { PLACED PACKED SHIPPED DELIVERED DISPUTED REFUNDED }

model SellerProfile {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  storeName      String    @unique
  ownerName      String
  email          String    @unique
  taxId          String
  kycStatus      KycStatus @default(PENDING)
  commissionRate Float     @default(12.0)
  tier           String    @default("Standard")
  products       Product[]
  orders         Order[]
  payouts        Payout[]
}

model BuyerProfile {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  email         String   @unique
  isPrime       Boolean  @default(false)
  walletBalance Float    @default(0.0)
  riskScore     String   @default("Low")
  status        String   @default("Active")
  orders        Order[]
}

model Product {
  id               String        @id @default(cuid())
  sku              String        @unique
  title            String
  category         String
  price            Float
  stock            Int
  moderationStatus String        @default("Pending Review")
  sellerId         String
  seller           SellerProfile @relation(fields: [sellerId], references: [id])
}

model Order {
  id              String        @id @default(cuid())
  buyerId         String
  sellerId        String
  totalAmount     Float
  platformFee     Float
  status          OrderStatus   @default(PLACED)
  escrowStatus    String        @default("Held in Escrow")
  disputeReason   String?
  buyer           BuyerProfile  @relation(fields: [buyerId], references: [id])
  seller          SellerProfile @relation(fields: [sellerId], references: [id])
}
